annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I've held to that even when I was angry
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If the only answer is that someone else ends up poorer
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have asked the organizer to pay each of us directly
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'm out a full $500 for work I did alone

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I stick to that even when it costs me
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: asked the organizer to confirm in writing who actually showed up
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: though it hurts to hand it over

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I wait two days, every time, even when waiting feels unbearable
annotations.pda_responsibility: I saw they weren't there that morning and just kept working
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A quick call to the organizer right then would probably have stopped the payment
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: lost the whole $500, and lost a bit of my own judgment

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't spend money to hurt someone I'll never see again.
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I've kept to that even when I badly wanted to break it.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What I regret is trusting a handshake.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: require both of us to sign off on the finished job
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Losing $300 wouldn't give me back my afternoon or my pay.

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I do it the same way each time, even when it costs me
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: would at least show the organizer that paying whoever turns up to collect is a weak system
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: insisted the money go to whoever signed the completion sheet
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: It's discouraging to walk away with nothing

annotations.sys_rule_justification: money already lost stays lost, and I don't throw more after it
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: it applies here too, however much I'd like an exception
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: it's my own loss I'm grieving, not theirs
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: asked the organizer to pay me my half directly, up front

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I use it even when failing it costs me something
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I lost a week's grocery money and some confidence
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: If I'd set up a check-in call the night before

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: That holds even when it drains my pocket
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: told the organizer I was working alone so the payment could be redirected
annotations.pda_responsibility: One sentence, and I didn't say it.
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: feel the extra hundred gone along with the five hundred

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I've stuck to that even when my pride wanted otherwise
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: A review wouldn't help me, the job, or even the organizer's next project
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: What aches is that the $500 was going toward rent
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: The organizer could have paid only after inspecting the work with both of us there

annotations.sys_rule_justification: when I can't know why someone did something, I don't pay to punish them
annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I apply that habit every time, even now, when it leaves me empty-handed
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I might turn down good work because of it
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I wish I'd kept a text record of what we agreed
